verdict.rationale: Morph has a first-party coding-agents guide. It covers Claude Code through its native `/v1/messages` Anthropic endpoint and Codex through an `edit_file` tool backed by morph-v3-fast, and an MCP guide connects AI tools to Morph's editing and search. However, no evidence shows integration guides for agent frameworks. Missing for 10: documented guides for agent frameworks (e.g., orchestration SDKs), breadth beyond Claude Code/Codex, independent hands-on corroboration of the guides.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the provider into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, first-party integration guides

citations.quote: Claude Code speaks the Anthropic Messages API, which Morph serves natively at `/v1/messages`.
Keep your current Codex model and give it `edit_file` backed by `morph-v3-fast` at 10,500+ tok/s (no gateway)
Connect your favorite AI tools to Morph's blazing-fast file editing via Model Context Protocol.
